machine: w2145 (see MACHINES.md; Hetzner dedicated Xeon W-2145, 8c/16t, 251 GiB; x86_64)
purpose: independent-machine + cross-architecture replication of the Section 1 checked-production cells (the published table cells remain the gb10 receipts; this directory is findings-grade evidence, deliberately outside the <machine>-retime best-of scan)
protocol: serial host lane; exactly 1 flagged warmup and 10 measured repeats per benchmark; whole checked-production wall; version-2 receipt (process wall + attribution); a second full campaign (produce-host-run2.json) as a same-box stability replication
retained_containers: retained to scratch to exercise the retain_copy_s phase at protocol parity with the gb10 campaign, verified by the runner's own byte gates, then deleted (not committed: the incumbents already bind the canonical bytes)
toolchain: cargo/rustc 1.97.1, release profile, --locked, built on the box

environment.co_tenancy: NOT a zero-co-tenant window: seventeen long-lived prover processes at nice 0 (~73% CPU each) plus one nice-10 grinder; load average ~19-20 of 16 threads throughout; the box’s Lean job queue empty before and during all kept cells (a Lean job arriving 2026-08-02T09:33:52Z invalidated only the checker-compare retain A/B cell, which was retired rather than re-taken: the version-2 receipts measure the retained-copy cost inline via rows_retain_copy_s, superseding that protocol for its own question; the invalidated attempt is committed as the overlap specimen)
environment.scheduler_calibration: single-threaded spin probe at nice 19/10/0, 3 repeats each, run under the same load: wall/cpu inflation 1.000-1.013 in all 9 cells (the co-tenants' ~27% sleep fraction leaves idle cores); residual contamination is all-core-turbo frequency and cache pressure, not scheduler starvation
environment.stability: run 1 vs run 2 medians agree within ~1-2% on every phase of every benchmark

promotion_rule: if any w2145 number is ever promoted into a rendered table, it must first be re-taken inside a true zero-co-tenant window per the MACHINES.md w2145 row; the numbers here are honest upper bounds for the box — concretely, under a declared admission gate in the style of ../QUIET-PROTOCOL.md, which landed after these cells were taken
progress: runner monitor emitted progress once per second
